ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What provides energy to all living beings?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The title in the image is “Food Chain”; in the upper right there is a bright sun, and sunlight shines toward the phytoplankton (phytoplankton) in the water. The image uses arrows to indicate energy flow, from phytoplankton to zooplankton, small fish, mackerel/mahi mahi, and finally to large shark. Reasoning: The energy in the food chain originally comes from the sun; producers such as phytoplankton absorb sunlight and then pass the energy to other organisms. Therefore, what provides energy for all organisms is the sun.
